heldout_001.fact_pattern: Tenant in Sacramento has rented an apartment under a month-to-month lease for 3 years without lease violation. Landlord serves an unstated 60-day notice to quit asserting an unconditional right to terminate without stating grounds.

heldout_002.fact_pattern: Fresno landlord increased the rent on a 1990 apartment building by 14% in a single notice, where regional CPI was 3.2%.

heldout_003.fact_pattern: Tenant filed a written habitability complaint regarding lack of hot water with the county health inspector. Two weeks later, landlord served a notice terminating tenancy and raising rent.

heldout_004.fact_pattern: Tenant provided 30 days written notice to landlord regarding a broken plumbing pipe causing ceiling leak. Landlord failed to respond or repair. Tenant hired a licensed plumber for $850 (monthly rent is $1,600) and deducted it from next rent.

heldout_005.fact_pattern: Landlord became frustrated with unpaid rent, changed the deadbolt locks while tenant was at work, and shut off electrical breaker to the unit for 6 days.

heldout_006.fact_pattern: Rental unit in Bakersfield has persistent sewage backup in shower, active black mold covering bedroom ceiling, and non-functional gas heating in mid-winter.

heldout_007.fact_pattern: San Francisco tenant in a pre-1979 multi-unit building receives a termination notice alleging the owner's cousin wants to move into the apartment.

heldout_008.fact_pattern: San Francisco landlord repeatedly threatens tenant with physical eviction, refuses to fix front door lock, and shuts down laundry room access to coerce tenant into vacating rent-controlled flat.

heldout_009.fact_pattern: Landlord holding a 10% minority tenant-in-common ownership interest in a 4-unit Berkeley building attempts an owner move-in eviction of a 12-year tenant.

heldout_010.fact_pattern: Los Angeles tenant in North Hollywood who accrued deferred rent during city emergency relief is served with a 3-day notice to pay or quit demanding lump sum payment without a statutory repayment installment schedule.

heldout_011.fact_pattern: San Jose landlord served a notice to quit on an apartment tenant under the Tenant Protection Ordinance but never submitted or filed a copy of the notice with the City's housing department.

heldout_012.fact_pattern: Landlord repeatedly sends late-night intimidating text messages threatening to break tenant's windows and remove tenant's belongings unless tenant accepts a cash buyout and moves.
